literals moved to CAPS with it (`use-section-data.ts` is the exception: its
label is a settings KEY, an identifier rather than a name).

Left for a follow-up: `branch-picker-dialog`, `run-again-dialog`,
`field-notes-dialog` and `settings-dialog/`. Each is one list or one input
behind the same header + footer shape, so nothing about them reads foreign
yet; convert one when it grows a choose-one field.

because that is how the three bespoke selectors this pass removed all began.
The one exemption is the story drawer's WORKSPACE placements: a cursor list
inside a well, because its choices are sentences a chip would stack three
rows tall.
